Her facial expressions are animated yet calm, and her hands gesture moderately to emphasize her points. She is positioned in an indoor room with warm, focused lighting and wooden bookshelves filled with items visible in the background. Large white Traditional Chinese subtitles are overlaid at the bottom. (2) The scene cuts to a medium-long shot of the same woman outdoors at night on a tennis court. She is dressed in athletic wear, including a dark t-shirt and light shorts, and is seen swinging a green tennis racket at a ball. Bright stadium floodlights illuminate the green court and the surrounding lush green trees under a dark night sky. (3) The video cuts back to the initial indoor studio setting. The woman continues her narrative to the camera, maintaining a steady gaze and using small, expressive hand movements. The environment remains consistent with its warm lighting and wooden shelving, creating a personal and informative atmosphere. (4) The final shot shows the woman sitting on a white stool against a light gray background with a yellow geometric accent on the side. She is wearing a blue denim shirt and smiling toward the camera. Large text in the center and top directs viewers to her YouTube channel.
